formal.quote:
∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
  (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    BasisObjects.content s (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ≤
      BasisObjects.content (s + 1) (ENNReal.ofReal δ) (A ×ˢ I)) ∧
  H s A ≤ H (s + 1) (A ×ˢ I)

comparison.difference: The source requires N003 instantiated on the fixed original Euclidean domain. In the actual T008 telescope, Type* in this premise elaborates to Type u_1, independently of the Type-0 Euclidean domain, as both saved compiler outputs show. Universe polymorphism of a producer declaration is lost when its instance is supplied as this fixed-universe local hypothesis. The missing direct specialization is confined to internal T typing and allowed-input wiring.
